name: Detective
desc: Sees what people try to hide. Trusts almost no one, including the client.

name: Physician
desc: Has closed more bodies than doors. Knows exactly how people come apart.

name: Nurse
desc: Did the work the physicians took credit for, in worse light and for less pay.

name: Mechanic
desc: If it moves, they can stop it. If it has stopped, they can usually make it move.

name: Soldier
desc: Survived a war nobody speaks well of. Keeps their back to walls.

name: Priest
desc: Carries a faith with cracks in it, and a voice that can still steady a room.

name: Professor
desc: An authority on something that suddenly matters far more than anyone expected.

name: Journalist
desc: Paid to notice inconsistencies. Constitutionally unable to stop asking.

name: Entertainer
desc: Can hold a hostile crowd for one more song. Has done so, recently.

name: Criminal
desc: Locks, pockets, and second-storey windows. Retired, allegedly.

name: Medium
desc: Half the séances were theatre. It is the other half that keeps them awake.

name: Railway Worker
desc: Thirty years of couplings, signals, and timetables. This train obeys none of them.

name: Socialite
desc: Knows which fork to use and which names open which doors.

name: Factory Worker
desc: Twelve-hour shifts breed endurance, and a good ear for a machine about to fail.

name: Hunter
desc: Reads tracks, wind, and silence. Knows when something is reading them back.

name: Lawyer
desc: Finds the loophole. Every contract has one, including, perhaps, a ticket.

name: Undertaker
desc: Dresses the dead for their last journey. Recognizes their condition on sight.

name: Cook
desc: Fed a hundred mouths a day from nothing. Knows meat when they see it.

name: Schoolteacher
desc: Can silence a room with a look and has buried more curiosity than most people ever feel.

name: Drifter
desc: Has ridden trains without tickets before. Never one like this.
